RT-001.rationale: The replay fixture contains two Kubernetes nodes and both report Ready=True.

RT-002.rationale: Deployment, StatefulSet and DaemonSet availability in the replay fixture matches their desired replica counts.

RT-003.rationale: Every replayed workload container defines at least one readiness, liveness or startup probe.

RT-004.rationale: Every replayed workload container defines non-empty CPU/memory requests and limits.

RT-005.rationale: Both replicated non-DaemonSet workloads are selected by a PodDisruptionBudget in the same namespace.

RT-006.rationale: All three replayed workloads are selected by a NetworkPolicy in the same namespace.
